title: Recursive sorting body
statement: For natural-number procedure indices $p_{\mathrm{sort}},p_{\mathrm{half}},p_{\mathrm{merge}},p_{\mathrm{copy}}$, define a statement that tests whether $1<\mathrm{Len}$. When this holds, it calls the halving procedure with argument $\mathrm{Len}$, calls the sorting procedure on the two segments with arguments $(\mathrm{Half},\mathrm{Start},\mathrm{Free})$ and $(\mathrm{Len}-\mathrm{Half},\mathrm{Start}+\mathrm{Half},\mathrm{Free})$, respectively, and then performs the merge and copy statement. When $1<\mathrm{Len}$ does not hold, it does nothing.
